name: BetterContact
description: Waterfall email & phone enrichment across 20+ providers. Async: enrich, then poll for the result.

methods.label: Enrich (submit)
methods.description: Submit up to 100 leads for waterfall email/phone enrichment. `data` is an array of leads, each with first_name, last_name, company, company_domain, linkedin_url (and optional custom_fields). Set enrich_email_address and/or enrich_phone_number. Returns { success, id } where `id` is the request id — poll Get Result with it. ASYNC: results are not ready immediately.

data.description: Array of leads (1-100). Each: { first_name, last_name, company, company_domain, linkedin_url, custom_fields }

enrich_email_address.description: Find a verified work email (default true)

webhook.description: Optional webhook URL POSTed when enrichment finishes

methods.label: Get Result (poll)
methods.description: Fetch enrichment results by request id (the `id` from Enrich). Returns { id, status, credits_consumed, credits_left, data[] } where status is 'pending' until done then 'terminated'. Each data item has contact_email_address, contact_email_address_status, contact_phone_number, contact_job_title, etc.
